title: SHORT EXTRACTION SIREN
why: His order 10-20: the extraction siren is intrusive. It now sounds 4 seconds at the call and 4 seconds before the ship arrives, not the whole time. The inbound ping stays.
now: The extraction siren sounds for 4 seconds after the call and the last 4 seconds before the ship arrives, then stops.
